reason: An external-service integration that replaces local spill storage with uploads of oversized DeepSeek Harness tool output to AWS S3, MinIO, Cloudflare R2, or another S3-compatible backend.

summaries.zh: 将 DeepSeek Harness 的超大工具输出上传到配置的 S3 兼容对象存储，以替代本地溢出存储。
summaries.en: Stores oversized DeepSeek Harness tool output in a configured S3-compatible object-storage backend instead of local spill storage.

capabilities: Uploads oversized tool-output text to a configured S3-compatible object-storage bucket
Resolves configured credential references for each upload
Provides CLI, presigned-URL, or locator-only retrieval guidance
